verification.environment: Isolated desktop/mobile browser and native-device acceptance with synthetic consent records; no customer records or live payouts. Owner attestation is collected separately.
requiredEvidence: Exact tested commit SHA, exact command, environment, scope, and limitations.
Hosted CI run and job URLs plus SHA-256 of the raw job log.
Full passed, failed, and skipped counts; no skipped acceptance cases; negative controls recorded as expected rejections.
Verified cleanup for created resources and immutable image digests when containers are used.
Synthetic-record mobile/browser evidence and owner attestation tied to the final exact SHA.
verification.completionCondition: All other criteria pass at the final exact SHA and the owner attests to the consent records and signs that SHA.
